INSTAGRAM
Planning Japan and Singapore with AI: Pokémon Centers, gelato and the prompt that stops you over-planning.

The prompt is on slide 2. Swap in your places, days and interests.
The line that matters: "no more than 3 big things a day". Without it you get an exhausting checklist.
AI plans, you verify. Check opening hours, prices and bookings on the official site before you go.
I'm logging every stop on Atlaria while I'm on the road.

Been to Japan? Drop the one thing I can't miss in the comments 👇
Follow @manrajtalks for the rest of the Travel with AI series.
